collection.title: Alpina D3 2005 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Alpina D3 2005 - 2014 requires a 24” wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19” for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the wiper blade to the arm.
